reason: I only need full-site screenshots now and then, when a project calls for it, and my extension gets it done for free. I'd poke at the free tier, but it's desktop only, and mobile is the view I actually care about, so it wouldn't prove anything to me.
objection: It's brand new with no reviews, and the login-capture feature wants my clients' browser sessions. I'm not handing that to a tool I've never heard of. Without that, it's just a nicer version of what I already do by hand for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A big redesign or audit project landing on my desk where I need every page on iPhone and Android at once. Letting the free tier capture one mobile device would also help, so I could see the quality before paying.
